author: TurkishDelite
body:
• Your minecraft username (most recent name if changed) : o_OBusterPalO_o
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned : TeamGrief - TNT
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server. : this is not a ban appeal but its a kick appeal since 1, i was not in the wrong and 2, a punishment like this can lead up to a ban. so apparently defending with TNT is not allowed... i attempted to blow up the sides of cherry landmc to stop people from ground pushing but someone triggered it off before i could finish placing the tnt down. zed saw the land blown up and without hesitation kicked me which i think was not fair.
    Evidence


  • as you can see i was blowing up the sides of the island for defence against ground pushers
  • P.S can i have these infractions removed as well

replies.body:
Hello Pal,

I've talked to the moderators that were spectating you and they have a very different story. In regards with the other infractions being removed we don't do that, we just ignore them if you weren't breaking a rule. This appeal is denied. 

Regards,
